title: MIPI RFFE-style bus master: register, extended and extended long write / read sequences

fields.desc: SCLK half period - 1 in PCLK (7 or more for reads from MIPI_RFFE_top)

regs.name: CMD
regs.desc: Command sequence; writing CMD commits it, the core takes it when idle

fdesc.cmd_type: 0 register 0 write, 1 register write, 2 register read, 3 extended write, 4 extended read, 5 extended long write, 6 extended long read, 7 reserved (no bus activity)

regs.name: WR
regs.desc: Write data byte for the next data frame (SCLK waits while WR is empty)

regs.name: RD
regs.desc: Read data byte; reading RD frees it

fields.desc: a read frame of the last finished sequence failed its parity

notes: sclk, sdata_o / sdata_oe and sdata_i are the bus pins (SDATA bidirectional with a bus holder); all pass through unchanged.
